design: PWKD261115D-04 Brushed Tech (per-template master test of C-04 / B-04)
locked: 2026-11-15 (MT). Every master is built from this file by build.py; nothing is hand-placed.
coordinates: y = percent of length from TIP (0%) to TAIL (100%). x = percent of the sheet width from the left edge. Mark sizes are physical (mm) so they print the same size on every product.

base.art: Kittl Nano Banana 2.1 4K clean brushed-aluminium plate (no marks), horizontal brush grain
base.color_match: each row of the plate is gain-matched to the C-04 round-3 row colour at the same % of length, so the gradient lands at identical % on every master

grain_mist.note: fine pale speckle on the black, density rising toward the tail

elements.color: auto-contrast: dark gray on silver, light silver on black

elements.type: vector text, Barlow Condensed Bold, centred

elements.note: B-04/C-04 has no stars; the dot rows above are its small-mark accents

board.note: re-composed at board width from this spec, not a stretch or crop of the ski master

split_sheet.cut: down the centre into split-L and split-R, each 7 in x 192 cm / 1050 x 11339 px

split_pair_seam_rule: Continuous elements (gradient, brush grain, orange block, caps) flow across the seam. No small mark or text may sit within 12 mm of the seam; the spec text block moves to the centre of the right ski (x = 75%) on the split sheet only, so no letter is cut.
rules: no brand names, logos or marks; no PowderWraps mark
contrasting orange accent on tip and tail
